implementation: Existing editors and game-content PUT dispatch V3 saves through owned project/version/path/source/schema checks. Read-only viewers/unknown owners remain read-only; legacy publication stays blocked.

Before filesystem replacement, CAS persists affected plan invalidation plus an exclusive host-edit Attempt/writer/fence. Exact prior JSON archived under .beegame, canonical candidate atomically replaced, actual saved/failed state settled; no native dispatch or forged Skill/measurement PASS.

Existing impact propagation includes actual projectBuild.files source-copy operands. Only affected owners/consumers reset for formal source edits; unrelated completed branch and all old Attempts/checks remain.

Changed current measurement requires authorized actual source-copy build and runtime-smoke. Old Preview/static/project export identity rejected. Actual changed source bytes produce new build/measurement; identical output bytes after changed requirements still require new Attempt and requirement-bound evidence.

Explicit requirement POST includes current Run/requirements versions, idempotent request key, full new text/constraints/IDs and authorized Task plan. Before/after/actor/time append-only; all current tasks read full requirements and are conservatively invalidated. Historical directed Review/Repair/Preview scopes cannot silently grant new-version authority.

Host edit records excluded from native transcript loading and labeled no-model/not-applicable usage. Editor saves update returned source/package/workflow versions and display unmeasured candidate; requirement UI retains drafts on conflict and never auto-dispatches.
New migration replaces host-only existing commit RPC, no new tables or native engine modifications. Production requires migration execution and independent real-database validation.

limitations: deliveryEligible:false. Schema, fresh build, browser smoke and source identities do not prove semantic request fulfillment, gameplay, aesthetics, audio, touch or complete game quality.
Source edit saves a candidate, not ownership-task success. Authorized authors may still need refinement/current Review; preserving semantic edit intent is not certified solely by prompt.

Filesystem and DB are not one transaction. Durable invalidation/writer precede replacement; interrupted or failed settlement retains unresolved writer. No timeout-based lease release or automatic cross-process recovery.

Whole confirmed requirement text is sent to every Task; full requirement changes revoke all task qualifications. This does not claim precise semantic-local impact analysis. Local JSON edits preserve unrelated successes only through declared/observed/build input evidence.
Real PostgreSQL migration, multi-worker CAS/permissions, unknown writer recovery and deployed full Dashboard editor/download interactions not executed.
Advanced explicit task-plan JSON confirmation implemented, not conversational initial planner or ordinary Chat automatic change generation.
